_note: Vale Mail product config (public, not secrets). Everything product-specific lives here so another company's version is a re-skin: names, agent identity, tenant + client IDs, own domain and copy. clientId stays empty until the Vale Mail app registration exists (morning setup step 3); while it is empty the page runs the demo mailbox.
